import csv
import os

def main():
    # Read indicator descriptions
    indicators = []
    input_path = "inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv"
    with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            indicators.append(row)

    # Define the 10-15 selected indicators relevant to urban mobility and livability
    # Covering mobility, population_density, environment, and living_conditions themes
    selected = [
        {
            "indicator_id": "M001",
            "indicator_name": "Public transport usage rate",
            "theme": "mobility",
            "justification": "Measures reliance on public transit, key for sustainable urban mobility",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "M002",
            "indicator_name": "Average commute time",
            "theme": "mobility",
            "justification": "Longer commutes reduce quality of life and productivity",
            "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "M003",
            "indicator_name": "Bicycle lane coverage",
            "theme": "mobility",
            "justification": "More bike lanes encourage non-motorized transport and reduce congestion",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "M004",
            "indicator_name": "Road traffic fatalities per 100k",
            "theme": "mobility",
            "justification": "Lower fatality rates indicate safer urban transport systems",
            "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "P001",
            "indicator_name": "Population density per km2",
            "theme": "population_density",
            "justification": "Higher density supports efficient public transit and services",
            "expected_direction": "contextual"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "P002",
            "indicator_name": "Housing affordability index",
            "theme": "population_density",
            "justification": "Affordable housing is critical for equitable urban living",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "P003",
            "indicator_name": "Urban population growth rate",
            "theme": "population_density",
            "justification": "Tracks urbanization trends for planning infrastructure",
            "expected_direction": "contextual"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "E001",
            "indicator_name": "PM2.5 concentration",
            "theme": "environment",
            "justification": "Lower PM2.5 levels indicate better air quality and health outcomes",
            "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "E002",
            "indicator_name": "Green space per capita",
            "theme": "environment",
            "justification": "More green space improves mental health and environmental quality",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "E003",
            "indicator_name": "Noise pollution level",
            "theme": "environment",
            "justification": "Lower noise levels contribute to better living conditions",
            "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "E004",
            "indicator_name": "Waste recycling rate",
            "theme": "environment",
            "justification": "Higher recycling rates indicate sustainable waste management",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "L001",
            "indicator_name": "Life expectancy",
            "theme": "living_conditions",
            "justification": "Higher life expectancy reflects better overall health and living standards",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "L002",
            "indicator_name": "Access to healthcare facilities",
            "theme": "living_conditions",
            "justification": "Better access ensures timely medical care for urban residents",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "L003",
            "indicator_name": "Internet penetration rate",
            "theme": "living_conditions",
            "justification": "High internet access supports digital inclusion and services",
            "expected_direction": "higher_is_better"
        },
        {
            "indicator_id": "L004",
            "indicator_name": "Unemployment rate",
            "theme": "living_conditions",
            "justification": "Lower unemployment indicates stronger local economy and well-being",
            "expected_direction": "lower_is_better"
        }
    ]

    # Ensure output directory exists
    os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)

    # Write output CSV
    output_path = "outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv"
    fieldnames = ["indicator_id", "indicator_name", "theme", "justification", "expected_direction"]
    with open(output_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in selected:
            writer.writerow(row)

    print(f"Written {len(selected)} indicators to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
